Synthetic chart sources under the OpenFGA chart repository key and its listed
chart path (charts/openfga). The tag names and commit ids of openfga-0.3.13,
openfga-0.3.14 and openfga-0.3.15 are the real ones; every file under them is
hand-written and invented, no byte comes from upstream. The benchmark-0.0.x,
openfga-operator-0.1.0 and openfga-0.3.16 tags have invented commit ids and
no files: the mapping must never read them.

openfga-0.3.13 -> openfga-0.3.14 is the hand-written oracle pair. Expected
refused keys, listed by hand in oracle.json and not derived by the reader:
  legacy.flag  the earlier schema and values have it, the later schema closes
               legacy to size only (one removed key)
  moved        the earlier values and schema have moved.oldPlace, the later
               ones have relocated.place and the closed root no longer
               declares moved (one moved key: a move is a removal of the old
               path, the new path is not a hint)
Not refused: annotations.tier, which the earlier values set and the later
ones drop, because annotations is an opaque map (additionalProperties is a
schema); it must never be listed.
openfga-0.3.14 -> openfga-0.3.15: no change, nothing refused.
